title: Marketing Action Plan
content:
Weeks 2–4 & ongoing

Engagement & Lead Capture

Open Houses & ShowingsPublic open houses with an inviting atmosphere, refreshments, and staging. Broker tours offering exclusive agent-only previews to drive early interest. Private VIP showings catered to serious buyers with personalized tours.
Lead Follow-UpImmediate follow-up with all interested parties within 24 hours. Follow Up Boss for tracking and nurturing leads. Personalized video messages to increase engagement.
Retargeting AdsFacebook and Google ads to re-engage people who visited the listing. Custom audience segments created for hyper-targeted follow-ups.
Ongoing

Adjustments & Market Analysis

Monitor EngagementTrack listing views, social media activity, and direct inquiries. Analyze website click-through rates and video watch times.
Adjust StrategyReassess pricing and positioning based on market feedback. Optimize ads and content to target higher-converting audiences. Implement minor staging or cosmetic updates if necessary.

Final goal: maximize exposure & sell for top dollar. This strategy ensures maximum property visibility, buyer engagement, and conversion. The multi-channel approach enhances credibility, while continuous optimization ensures a competitive edge in the market.
